name: deepseek-moby
description: AI coding assistant for VS Code, powered by DeepSeek

moby.model.markdownDescription: Which model to use. Built-ins: `deepseek-v4-pro-thinking`, `deepseek-v4-flash-thinking`, `deepseek-chat`, `deepseek-reasoner`. Also accepts any `id` declared in `#moby.customModels#`.

moby.customModels.markdownDescription: Custom models to register alongside the built-ins (e.g. a local Ollama or LM Studio endpoint). Each entry declares one model and its capabilities. See `docs/guides/custom-models.md` for a walkthrough.

id.description: Model ID sent in the API request body (e.g. "qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct"). Must not conflict with a built-in ID.

name.description: Display name shown in the model selector UI.

enumDescriptions: Model supports OpenAI-format function_calling (tool_calls / tool_use blocks returned in the API response).
No native tool support. Model must express actions via inline text protocols (see editProtocol / shellProtocol).
toolCalling.description: Whether the model supports native tool calling via the OpenAI function-calling API.

enumDescriptions: Model emits a separate reasoning_content channel in the stream (R1-style chain-of-thought).
No separate reasoning channel. Thinking, if any, is inline in the content stream.
reasoningTokens.description: Whether the model returns a separate reasoning / chain-of-thought channel.

enumDescriptions: Edits expressed via apply_code_edit / create_file / delete_file tool calls. Requires toolCalling: "native".
Edits expressed as SEARCH/REPLACE blocks in the model's text response. Works for models without native tool calling.

editProtocol.description: Ordered preference for how file edits are expressed. Use ["native-tool"] for tool-calling models, ["search-replace"] for text-protocol models. Can combine (e.g. ["native-tool", "search-replace"]) to allow fallback.

enumDescriptions: R1-style <shell>...</shell> tags in the model's text response. Needed for agentic work when toolCalling is "none".
No inline shell protocol. Model can't run commands unless it has native tool calling.
shellProtocol.description: How the model expresses shell commands. Pair with editProtocol: ["search-replace"] for full R1-style agentic work on non-tool-calling models.

supportsTemperature.description: Whether the model accepts the temperature parameter (reasoning models often don't).

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum completion tokens the model can produce per response.

maxTokensConfigKey.description: VS Code config key used to override maxOutputTokens per model. Invent a unique key like "maxTokensCustomQwen".

streaming.description: Whether to use streaming (SSE) responses. Usually true for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

apiKey.description: API key. Some local runners accept any non-empty string (Ollama uses "ollama"). Omit to fall back to the global moby.apiKey secret.

enumDescriptions: DeepSeek V3 / R1 tokenizer (bundled). Exact counting via WASM.
tokenizer.description: Optional: bundled tokenizer for exact counting. Omit to use estimation (character-based heuristic that auto-calibrates from API usage.prompt_tokens within a few requests).

enumDescriptions: Standard OpenAI chat-completions wire format. Works for Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Moonshot, Groq, LiteLLM, etc.
requestFormat.description: Wire format for the API request/response. Only "openai" is supported today.

subagentRoles.markdownDescription: Subagent roles this model may serve when selected in `moby.subagents`. A model not declaring a role is skipped and the raw input passes through unchanged.

acceptsImages.markdownDescription: Model accepts image content (OpenAI `image_url` blocks). Required for the `image-describe` role — DeepSeek's first-party API is text-only, so point this at a vision-capable endpoint (e.g. SiliconFlow `deepseek-ai/deepseek-vl2`).

temperatureFixedValue.markdownDescription: Pin the request temperature to exactly this value, overriding the global `moby.temperature`. For providers that accept only one temperature — Kimi rejects anything but `1`.

streamingToolCalls.markdownDescription: Model streams tool-call deltas (OpenAI-style `tool_calls` in stream chunks). When true, Moby uses the single streaming pipeline instead of the legacy probe-then-stream loop — halving wall-clock on tool turns. Enable only if the provider actually streams tool calls.

disableThinkingParam.markdownDescription: The provider's own request params for turning reasoning OFF, merged into the request body when Moby needs a non-thinking call (all subagent roles — web-search digests, image descriptions). There is no portable OpenAI-compatible knob, so declare your provider's: e.g. `{"enable_thinking": false}` (Qwen-style) or `{"reasoning_effort": "none"}`. Omit if the provider has none — the model then can't be turned off, and Moby uses your cheapest declared level instead of guessing at a param.

defaultThinkingLevel.markdownDescription: Which `thinkingLevels` key applies when the user hasn't picked one. Must name a declared level.

noSamplingParamsWhenThinking.markdownDescription: The provider rejects `temperature`/`top_p`/`presence_penalty`/`frequency_penalty` **while reasoning**. Applied per request, so a non-thinking turn on the same model keeps them. Use `supportsTemperature: false` instead when the provider never accepts temperature at all.

enumDescriptions: Standard OpenAI field (default)
Required by OpenAI's reasoning models and Kimi K3 — note this budget also covers the reasoning trace, so the same number yields less visible output
maxTokensParam.markdownDescription: Which request field carries the max-output value. OpenAI's reasoning models **reject** `max_tokens`. Not a pure rename: `max_completion_tokens` is spent on the reasoning trace as well as the answer.

extraParams.markdownDescription:
Request params merged into **every** request for this model — the escape hatch for provider fields Moby doesn't model (e.g. `safety_settings`, `service_tier`, a local runner's `num_ctx`). Moby never interprets these; they go straight to the wire.

Merged *before* thinking params, so a declared `thinkingLevels` entry always wins — otherwise setting `reasoning_effort` here would silently deaden the effort pill.

Cannot set `model`, `messages`, `stream`, `tools`, `max_tokens`, or `max_completion_tokens` — Moby computes those (use `maxTokensParam` to choose the token field's name).

wireModelId.markdownDescription: Model id to send on the wire, when it differs from `id`. Rarely needed — only when you want a distinct id in Moby's settings and picker.

enumDescriptions: Provider 400s unless prior assistant turns carry reasoning_content back (DeepSeek V4, Kimi K3)
Accepted but not required
Stripped from history before sending (default)
reasoningEcho.markdownDescription: Whether `reasoning_content` must be echoed back on assistant turns in later requests. Set `required` for reasoning models that reject history without it — the usual symptom is a 400 on the *second* iteration of a tool loop, not the first.

contextWindow.markdownDescription: Total context window (input + output) in tokens. Drives the conversation-history budget and the tool loop's "approaching budget" guard. Defaults to 128,000 when omitted.

maxOutputTokensCap.markdownDescription: Upper bound for this model's max-tokens slider. Defaults to `maxOutputTokens` when omitted — set it when the provider's ceiling is far above the practical default.

lspTools.markdownDescription: Expose the LSP-backed navigation tools (`outline`, `find_symbol`, `hover`, `get_diagnostics`, …) to this model. Requires `toolCalling: "native"`.

command.description: Executable to spawn (on PATH, or an absolute path). Runs with your user's permissions.

args.description: Arguments passed to the command. No variable expansion — literal strings only.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process. No variable expansion.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process. Defaults to the extension host's.

enabled.description: Set false to keep the entry but not spawn the server.

moby.temperature.description: [Chat model only] Creativity level (0=deterministic, 2=creative). Reasoner does not support temperature.

moby.maxToolCalls.description: [Chat model only] Maximum tool calling iterations per request. Each iteration can have multiple tool calls. (100 = no limit)

moby.maxShellIterations.description: [Reasoner model only] Maximum shell command iterations per request. (100 = no limit)

moby.maxFileEditLoops.description: [Reasoner model only] Maximum continuations after R1 produces file edits (allows running install/build commands after writing files). (100 = no limit)

moby.maxTokensChatModel.description: [Chat model only] Maximum output tokens per response. Max: 8,192

moby.maxTokensReasonerModel.description: [Reasoner model only] Maximum output tokens per response. Max: 65,536

moby.maxTokensV4FlashThinking.description: [DeepSeek V4 Flash (Thinking)] Maximum output tokens per response. Default: 65,536; API cap: 384,000.

moby.maxTokensV4ProThinking.description: [DeepSeek V4 Pro (Thinking)] Maximum output tokens per response. Default: 65,536; API cap: 384,000.

enumDescriptions: Model reasons before answering (default)
Skip reasoning — faster and cheaper. Only honoured by models that declare an off-knob.
thinking.description: Turn reasoning on or off for this model.

thinkingLevel.markdownDescription: How hard the model reasons. Values are model-declared — DeepSeek V4 takes `high`/`max`; Kimi K3 takes `low`/`high`/`max`. Ignored (with a warning) if the model doesn't declare it.

reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: **Deprecated** — use `thinkingLevel`. Still read so settings written by 0.8.0 keep working.

moby.showStatusBar.description: Show status bar with token usage

enumDescriptions: Show all messages including debug info
Show info, warnings and errors
Show warnings and errors (default)
Show errors only
Disable logging
moby.logLevel.description: Extension Output: Minimum log level to display in Output channel

enumDescriptions: Show all messages including debug info
Show info, warnings and errors
Show warnings and errors only (default)
Show errors only
moby.webviewLogLevel.description: Webview Console: Minimum log level for browser console logging

moby.tracing.enabled.description: Enable trace collection for debugging and AI-agent observability

moby.tavilySearchesPerPrompt.description: Number of web searches allowed per prompt request

enumDescriptions: Basic search (1 credit per search)
Advanced search with deeper content extraction (2 credits per search)
Off: Web search is completely disabled
Manual: Web search only when manually toggled on by the user
Auto: The LLM decides when to search the web (recommended)
moby.webSearchMode.description: Controls how web search works: off (disabled), manual (user toggle only), or auto (LLM decides)

enumDescriptions: Tavily — hosted, paid; requires an API key from tavily.com
SearXNG — self-hosted metasearch; free, no API key; requires a running instance
moby.webSearch.provider.description: Which web search backend to use. Tavily is the default. SearXNG is ideal for local-first / privacy-focused setups.

moby.webSearch.searxng.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of your SearXNG instance (e.g. `http://localhost:8080`). JSON format must be enabled in the instance's `settings.yml` (`search.formats: [html, json]`).

moby.webSearch.searxng.engines.description: Which SearXNG engines to query. Leave empty to use the instance's default engine set. Common values: google, bing, duckduckgo, brave, wikipedia, github, stackoverflow.

moby.subagents.markdownDescription: Per-role subagent routing. Each key is a subagent role; the value is a registered model id (e.g. `"deepseek-v4-flash-thinking"`) or `"off"`. Off by default. The configured model must declare the role in its `subagentRoles` capability. See `docs/plans/subagents.md`.

web-search-digest.description: Compress web_search responses into a ranked digest before they reach the main model. Set to "off" to disable, or to a model id (e.g. "deepseek-v4-flash-thinking") to enable.

image-describe.description: Describe attached images via a vision model, injecting a text digest into the conversation. Set to "off", or to a custom model id that declares acceptsImages + the image-describe role.

additionalProperties.description: Other subagent roles (search-digest, file-summarize, tool-classify, image-describe). Same model-id-or-"off" shape.

moby.subagents.webSearchDigest.maxResult.description: Output cap for the web-search digest subagent. The subagent receives the full web-search results and propagates only the N most relevant to the main model. Range 1–20; default 5. The web-search popup exposes a slider for this.

enumDescriptions: Manual: Click Diff then Apply (current behavior)
Ask: Auto-show diff and prompt for confirmation
Auto: Automatically apply changes without asking (coming soon)
moby.editMode.description: How to handle code edits from AI responses

moby.allowAllShellCommands.markdownDescription: Allow ALL shell commands without approval prompts. Disables the safety blocklist that prevents destructive operations like `rm -rf /`. Use with caution.

moby.devMode.markdownDescription: **Developer Mode**: Enable dev tools for UI development. Shows a floating token editor panel (Ctrl+Shift+I) that allows real-time adjustment of spacing and style tokens across all shadow DOM components.

moby.editSafety.checkpoint.markdownDescription: **Edit safety — checkpoint**: In Auto mode, snapshot each file before an auto-applied edit so a batch can be reverted to its last-good state. Pure safety; invisible on the happy path. (ADR 0006)

moby.editSafety.validate.markdownDescription: **Edit safety — post-apply validation**: After an Auto-mode edit batch, validate against the project's own toolchain. `auto` discovers the check command from workspace markers (dotnet build / npm run / make / cargo check / go build); `off` disables the gate; or set an explicit command string to run. A confirmed regression reverts the batch and feeds the errors back to the model.

moby.editSafety.validateTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: **Edit safety — validation timeout**: Hard timeout (ms) for the post-apply check command. A timeout is treated as inconclusive (not a regression).

moby.editSafety.maxRepairAttempts.markdownDescription: **Edit safety — per-file repair budget**: how many times a single file may revert with the *same* build error in a row before the turn halts. Failures across different files don't accumulate, and a changing error resets the count. Auto mode stays Auto — it never demotes to per-edit approval.

moby.editSafety.onInconclusive.markdownDescription: **Edit safety — inconclusive outcome**: When validation can't run (no check command discovered, timed out, or not approved): `commit` applies the edit with a note (Auto's default expectation); `halt` stops the turn instead. There is deliberately no 'ask' — Auto never becomes Ask.

moby.editSafety.verifyOnStop.markdownDescription: **Edit safety — verify on stop**: At turn completion (Auto mode), don't accept a model-declared "done" when the last build verdict was a regression or when a file the turn just wrote reads back empty. Re-consults the ADR 0006 build verdict and adds a language-agnostic artifact-presence check, giving the model one bounded repair pass. Bounded by the per-file repair budget — no new loop. (ADR 0011)

moby.requestTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds before an API request is aborted. Raise this for slow providers — reasoning models and vision backends routinely take 30s or more, and a timeout mid-turn loses the whole turn. Applies to every endpoint, including custom models.

scripts.build:wasm: cd packages/moby-wasm && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release
scripts.package: npm run build:media && webpack --mode production --devtool hidden-source-map
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:actors && npm run test:events && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e:harness: playwright test tests/e2e/webview-rendering.spec.ts tests/e2e/golden-rendering.spec.ts tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/composer-autocomplete.spec.ts
